build_roc_cross_validation: build an ROC curve with cross-validation using StratifiedKFold and cross_validate on an SVM classifier
create_roc_display_from_cv: create a ROC curve display from cross-validation results with fold-wise curves and chance level using RocCurveDisplay.from_cv_results
calculate_mean_auc_std: calculate the mean AUC and standard deviation from interpolated ROC curves across cross-validation folds
visualize_roc_variability: visualize ROC curve variability across folds with mean curve and ±1 std. dev. shaded region
load_iris_binarize_dataset: load the iris dataset and binarize it by dropping one class for binary classification ROC analysis
